performance_question: Compare gateway orchestration throughput and stability against the stock Dynamo frontend.

comparisons.mooncake: No comparison to Dynamo is valid because the reference and two candidates failed the stress cell.

repeat_decision.rationale: A series noise-floor pilot (n=3 total) is required before promotion based on modest valid-cell deltas; categorical Mooncake failures do not require repetition to establish instability.
repeat_decision.expected_decision: Distinguish the Envoy variants and AGW generic from run-to-run noise after fixing their stress failures.

client_visible_symptoms: AGW generic reset 228 Mooncake requests when its pod was OOM-killed.
Envoy callouts returned 108633 empty streams after prepare-callout gRPC LocalReset.
The stock Dynamo reference accepted no successful Mooncake requests in the six-client stress cell.
limitations: Mock-worker throughput characterizes gateway orchestration, not GPU token generation.
The Mooncake workload is a deliberate compressed stress replay and includes a large timestamp-zero burst.
AIPerf output-length mismatch warnings are expected with deterministic mock workers and are not GPU engine measurements.
